Your marshals — loyalty, glory, and grievance. Gold answers loyalty; only glory answers envy. Press G to close.

  OUR DOCTRINE — The Corps System  ▸ the doctrine

  THE EMPEROR
 
[8] Napoleon  [Infantry]  France
In the field at Lorraine — The Presence goes where he stands.
  ★ The Presence  +10% here at Lorraine  Every French corps fighting in the Emperor's province gains +10% attack and defense. Enemy commanders will not attack his army at odds they would accept against any marshal.

  Strength: 10,000 / 10,000  Morale: 85%  Range: 1
     Tactical 10  combat dice (+1 per 3 pts)
     Shock 7  attack damage (+5%/pt)
     Defense 7  damage resistance (-5%/pt)
     Logistics 8  answers the guns (+5 muster/pt)
     Administration 9  recruit pricing (thrifty 8+, wasteful 3-)
     Command 10  rally & recovery (fast 8+, poor 3-)
  The Intendance: raises recruits 15% under standard cost.
  The Rally: reforms beaten armies at double pace — retreat and broken recovery advance 2 stages/turn.
